# Marky v1.7.1

A maintenance release. The headline is that Linux x86_64 has packages again.

### Fixed

- **Linux x86_64 builds are back.** v1.7.0 shipped with no `.deb`, `.rpm` or
  AppImage for x86_64 — the release build stalled partway through downloading a
  system dependency and hit its step timeout, so only arm64 Linux made it out.
  If you are on a 64-bit Intel or AMD Linux machine, this is the release to
  install.
- **The window resizes freely again.** Marky previously refused to be made
  shorter than 900px, which meant it could not fit on a 1366x768 screen at all.
  The minimum size limits are gone.
- **Live mode no longer scrolls sideways around code blocks.** A fenced block
  with a long line could push the whole note into horizontal scrolling instead
  of scrolling inside the block, so the text you were writing drifted off the
  edge. It showed up whenever the editor pane was narrower than the editor width
  set in Settings — a narrow window, or split view. The block scrolls on its
  own again and the note stays put.

### Changed

- The sidebar toggle in the title bar is now a single control that turns its
  chevron around, rather than two buttons whose styling had drifted apart.

### Under the hood

- Release builds now run the test suite, not just the linter, so a tag pushed
  to a branch CI never gated cannot publish untested.
- The test runner was picking up a duplicated copy of the MCP server suite from
  pnpm's store and running 30 tests twice against a snapshot that only refreshed
  on install. Now it runs each test once, against the real source.
- Generated Tauri schema files are no longer tracked, so a local build stops
  leaving the working tree dirty.

### Downloads

- macOS Apple Silicon: `aarch64` DMG. macOS Intel: `x64` DMG.
- Windows: setup EXE or MSI for your architecture.
- Linux: AppImage, DEB, or RPM for your architecture.

macOS builds are not yet signed with an Apple Developer ID. If macOS says the
app is damaged, run `xattr -cr /Applications/Marky.app` once after installing.
